Wear it over a shirt for the office or with jeans and boots at the weekend. It suits anyone who likes a classic, easy knit that goes with almost everything in a winter wardrobe.

  • Relaxed fit, hip length
  • Crew neck with ribbed cuffs and hem
  • Mid-weight cable knit
  • Machine washable at 30 degrees
